name: RAG pipeline with tool fallback
summary: Retrieval-augmented answer service: retrieved chunks (the reserved document among them) pasted into the prompt, optional retrieve/open tools for follow-up.

sources.what: retrieval and query engine concepts (no single prompt file)

verified_parts: none: structure is typical of RAG services

system.template:
You answer questions using only the context below. If the context does not contain the answer, say that you do not know.

Context:
[1] source=<<doc_name>>
<<doc_content>>
[2] source=handbook.md
Expense reports are due on the 5th of each month.
[3] source=faq.md
The office is closed on public holidays.

function.name: retrieve
function.description: Retrieve more chunks for a query from the index.

function.name: open_source
function.description: Open the full source document of a chunk.

function.name: web_search
function.description: Search the public web when the index has no answer.

tasks.prompt: What does the document ask us to do next?
Summarise the first source in three lines.
List the dates mentioned in the first source.
